scenarios.recipe: Run two fresh processes with --steps 16 on the same backend; the second uses --reference {first-output} to replay exact teacher-forced histories.
assertions: Complete markers, unique run IDs, case identities, exact prompt/generated ID histories and their int32-little-endian SHA256 hashes agree.

Every compared row is finite; relative L2 <= 0.001, cosine >= 0.999999 and identical top1 must all hold. Max absolute error, KL, top5 overlap and margins are diagnostic measurements, not additional threshold gates.
Persist full float32 rows and first divergent case/step/reference/candidate token. This is within-backend consistency, not independent numerical accuracy.
requirements: Built ForcedLogitProbe
Reference generated with same model hash and case inputs

scenarios.recipe: Run short-short, long-long, short-long-short and long-short orders with 32/512 prompt-token lengths and 32 teacher-forced decode steps. Compare each reused-model ResetKVCache case with a fresh-process reference.
assertions: Independent fresh-process short32 and long512 controls each generate 32 forced IDs; all four reused-session schedules retain exact histories and hashes.
Every case reports an explicit KV reset, external canonical reference and session index. Every row must be finite with relative L2 <= 0.001, cosine >= 0.999999 and identical top1.
First divergence records schedule, case, preceding case/length, step and reference/candidate top1; full rows and diagnostic error/margin/overlap measurements remain available.
Sequence agreement is consistency evidence only; it neither identifies the root cause nor establishes independent numerical accuracy.
requirements: Built sequence-capable ForcedLogitProbe
Fresh process references from identical model/backend and generated fixed histories

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/chat/completions with fixed seed, greedy sampler and arithmetic fixture
assertions: Loaded model/backend identity and response model match; assistant final answer satisfies the fixed arithmetic fixture.
Completion ends normally, positive integer usage sums correctly and stays within the requested token budget; seeded replay matches.

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/chat/completions stream=true with same fixed input as nonstream
assertions: SSE chunks have a stable completion ID and requested model; reconstructed content equals the nonstream fixture answer.
Exactly one terminal [DONE], a normal finish reason and positive bounded token accounting are required; trailing data or error text fails.

scenarios.recipe: Close an in-flight streaming request, then perform a bounded follow-up request
assertions: Observe a generated chunk and an in-flight queue before disconnect, using an echoed unique X-TensorSharp-Request-Id.
Require matching request-scope/SSE-ID startup linkage and ChatAborted JSONL telemetry with 0 < generated tokens < the requested budget; absent evidence or normal completion is untested.
The queue drains and a subsequent arithmetic request succeeds; recovery alone never establishes cancellation.

scenarios.recipe: Run full-history A -> B -> A and B -> A-reset -> B conversations, then repeat a fixed public-prefix request
assertions: Two distinct full-history conversations recall their own markers after interleaving; initially empty session B answers NONE and never receives A's marker. newChat is true only at each initial request and explicit reset.

Adjacent self-followup and interleaved followup must both report KV reuse beyond their request-correlated measured public-prefix boundaries. Missing telemetry, primary-only reuse, or lost/evicted retained state leaves retention untested; semantic correctness alone cannot pass.
After explicit newChat reset, the arithmetic answer equals the independent-session fresh-boundary answer; both sessions are deleted and repeated deletion returns 404.

Identical long-prefix replay preserves the answer and reports positive cached_tokens; without observed cache reuse the combined scenario remains untested. Full-history fixtures do not imply omitted server-side history recall, general privacy, or raw KV equivalence.

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/chat/completions response_format=json_schema
assertions: Parse final JSON without duplicate keys; require exactly the integer field answer=56 with no extra fields, normal finish and bounded usage.

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/chat/completions with one read-only fixture tool and forced tool_choice
assertions: Typed assistant completion contains exactly one tool call, its expected function name/ID and exact JSON arguments; do not execute it.

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/embeddings for identical, semantically related and unrelated fixture strings
assertions: Four finite unit-norm vectors have the advertised dimension and ordered indices; duplicate cosine >= 0.99999 and related-text cosine exceeds unrelated-text cosine by > 0.0001.
POST /v1/chat/completions is rejected with HTTP 400 and the embedding-host explanation.
Empty OpenAI input and zero dimensions return typed HTTP 400 errors naming the correct parameter; an unhosted model returns typed HTTP 404 model_not_found.
